ambient_events: The drain gurgles once and settles.
Linen is refolded on the bench by somebody who has folded a great deal of linen.
The door at the far end doesn't open. You hadn't asked it to.
Water runs somewhere behind the wall, for a long time, and stops all at once.
description:
Whitewash, a drain in the middle of the floor, and a chair bolted down over it under a hood of salvaged medical gear. Along one wall, a bench with a great deal of clean linen folded on it and a bucket underneath. At the far end there's a second door, plain, with no handle on it.

The room smells of soap and, under the soap, of something else.
name: The Stillhouse
